Live, synchronized operational data is held in reusable 'Cards' that produce C2 charts, maps and briefs so staffs plan against a single live picture rather than static slides (description per api-evangelist third-party API-surface profile, 2026-07-31, and company PRs). OUTPUT: plans, orders, sync-matrix and C2 charts, briefs, map overlays. USER: division/corps/joint staffs (G3/G5/J3/J5), air operations/mission command cells (ACC EMC3 project).

companies.exact_problem_solved: Military staffs spend hours re-building PowerPoint/Excel planning products from disconnected data; Onebrief collapses the staff-planning cycle (MDMP/JPP) into one synchronized workspace so plan changes propagate to every product.
